prompt:
I've been keeping a messy personal activity log at ~/raw_activity_log.txt on my laptop. It has notes about three recurring activities I want to stay consistent with — client calls (only on workdays), daily journaling, and exercise (which I aim to do 3 times a week on flexible days).

Can you set up a proper tracking workspace for me under ~/habits/? I'd like each activity to have its own dedicated file with all the historical entries properly recorded from my raw log, and I want to be able to see how I'm doing streak-wise for each one. Please also create a file called summary.md that gives me an overview across all three habits — including how often I'm completing each one, which days of the week tend to be my strongest and weakest, and where my streaks currently stand.

The workspace should reflect the actual numbers from my log, not just empty templates.
